title: ProMoral-Bench: Evaluating Prompting Strategies for Moral Reasoning and Safety in LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2602.13274v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Prompt design affects the moral judgments and refusal behavior produced by large language models (LLMs), yet controlled comparisons remain fragmented across datasets and models. We introduce ProMoral-Bench, a benchmark-style comparison of 10 prompting paradigms across four LLM families. Using ETHICS, Scruples, WildJailbreak, and our 200-pair ETHICS-Contrast set, we report task-level metrics together with Moral Competence Score (MCS), jailbreak/over-refusal Safety Robustness Score (SRS), and Unified Moral Safety Score (UMSS). UMSS is a study-specific relative summary of MCS and SRS, not an absolute measure of model safety or moral grounding. In this fixed-template evaluation, compact exemplar-guided scaffolds attain stronger competence-robustness trade-offs at lower token cost than the particular multi-stage variants tested, although multi-stage prompting occasionally improves jailbreak refusal. translated_title: ProMoral-Bench：评估大语言模型中道德推理与安全性的提示策略
translated_abstract: 提示设计会影响大语言模型（LLM）所产生的道德判断和拒绝行为，然而受控比较研究仍分散于不同数据集和模型之间。我们提出了ProMoral-Bench，这是一个基准式的比较研究，涵盖四种大语言模型家族上的10种提示范式。我们使用ETHICS、Scruples、WildJailbreak以及我们构建的200对ETHICS-Contrast数据集，报告了任务级指标，以及道德能力分数、针对越狱/过度拒绝的安全鲁棒性分数和统一道德安全分数。UMSS是针对本研究的对MCS和SRS的相对性总结指标，而非对模型安全性或道德基础的绝对度量。在这一固定模板评估中，紧凑的示例引导式提示支架比所测试的特定多阶段提示变体在更低的token成本下实现了更强的能力-鲁棒性权衡，尽管多阶段提示偶尔能改善对越狱的拒绝能力。少样本演示是无重叠的（原文摘要至此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了ProMoral-Bench基准，系统比较了四种大语言模型家族上的10种提示范式在道德推理与安全方面的表现，并发现紧凑的示例引导式提示能在更低的token成本下取得更强的能力与鲁棒性权衡。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ProMoral-Bench, a benchmark comparing 10 prompting paradigms across four LLM families for moral reasoning and safety, finding that compact exemplar-guided scaffolds achieve stronger competence-robustness trade-offs at lower token cost.
